pattern: relative percent growth of a yearly total, not percentage points
question: by what percent did total loan disbursement grow from 2023 to 2024
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN "Disbursement Date" >= '2024-01-01' AND "Disbursement Date" < '2025-01-01' THEN "Loan Amount (Rs)" ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "Disbursement Date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Disbursement Date" < '2024-01-01' THEN "Loan Amount (Rs)" ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN "Disbursement Date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Disbursement Date" < '2024-01-01' THEN "Loan Amount (Rs)" ELSE 0 END) AS growth_percent FROM shg_loan_register
sql_duckdb: WITH disbursement AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE)) AS yr, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_disbursement FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE))) SELECT (d2.total_disbursement - d1.total_disbursement) * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(d1.total_disbursement, 0), 0) AS growth_percent FROM disbursement AS d1 JOIN disbursement AS d2 ON d1.yr = 2023 AND d2.yr = 2024

by what percent did total loan disbursement grow from 2023 to 2024
attempts.response:
WITH disbursement AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE)) AS yr,
    SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_disbursement
  FROM "shg_loan_register"
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE))
)
SELECT
  (d2.total_disbursement - d1.total_disbursement) * 100.0 / NULLIF(d1.total_disbursement, 0) AS growth_percent
FROM disbursement d1
JOIN disbursement d2
  ON d1.yr = 2023
  AND d2.yr = 2024;
